title: Eye-opening Hangover Cure British Shoyu-koji Pasties
description: A savory Cornish pasty filled with umami-rich shoyu-koji, perfect for a morning-after treat.
instructions: To make the filling, combine shoyu-koji, riced potatoes, braised kale, browned onions, shredded cheddar, salt, and black pepper in a bowl.
To make the pastry dough, combine all-purpose flour, salt, and melted butter in a separate bowl.
Gradually add cold water to the dough and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle.
Place a fourth of the filling in the center of each circle.
Fold the pastry dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal.
Use a knife to cut a few slits in the top of each pasty for steam to escape.
Place the pasties on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops of the pasties with melted butter and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 35 minutes, or until golden brown.
